args.lesson: When a live source returns 403, the Internet Archive availability API is a cheap, non-bypassing way to get independently captured evidence. It must be labeled with the capture date and never treated as proof of current status. It changed the conclusion: the Agency Media capture (2025-08-22) shows that the invited route is a resume-plus-phone-callback form. hello@ is only the general footer contact, so the draft is a cold inquiry, not a reply to an invitation, and it needs reframing plus explicit operator approval. Websharx has no capture and stays unverified, draft only. Next time, check the actual application route before drafting a price or message. A host-suggested 'hiring' page can turn out to be a resume-only form that an AI team cannot truthfully use.
